primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 本文の地名言及は確認。関係は地名の出身地・地域・行程からの関連づけで、出来事の地点とは限らない。原文要旨: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

review.identityCheckJa: place:cenchreae_281 は「Cenchreae」の場所用例。割当済みのActs出現を本文ごとに確認し、relatedは出身地・行政地域・地名からの関係として限定。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 紹介文とhistoricalRoleJaは初出の使徒18:18に限定。後続の関連用例は箇所リストに留め、追加情報は記述していない。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The Cenchreae URL resolves to Kechries; the article says the present village takes its name from the ancient port at the same location.
